title: test(metadata-fs): external-write-resync drives the sweep at its seam, 24 s to 3.3 s (#23182 row 4)
body:
Part of #23182 (row 4)
Clause-②: no

This PR covers row 4 of #23182 only: `@objectstack/metadata-fs`, `test/external-write-resync.test.ts`, 24.3 s in run `38217670691`. It changes one test file and no production file. #23182 stays open for rows 1, 3, 5 and 6.

## Where the 24 s went

Per case at BASE `6f4c518b01` (vitest, ms): create/update/delete 6042–6169, exactly-once 6082–6124, unreadable directory 7030–7048, ENOENT 5012–5018, close 6.

All of it was idle waiting, on two things:

- **The sweep's 2 s cadence.** The first case waited for three sweeps in a row: create, then update, then delete. The cadence is `RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS`, a private constant in `src/repository.ts` that no option sets. Making it injectable would widen `FileSystemRepositoryOptions`, a published production surface, so I did not take that route.
- **Three fixed 5 s quiet windows** (`QUIET_WINDOW_MS`), in the exactly-once, unreadable-directory and ENOENT cases.

## What changed (test only)

- **One recovery still waits for the clock.** In the first case, the scheduled sweep recovers the lost create with nobody calling anything. The deadline is `RECOVERY_WAIT_MS` (15 s, unchanged). The case now also requires the chain to re-arm after that sweep: `resyncTimer` must be set again. This keeps the half of the pin that says the backstop runs by itself and keeps running.
- **Every other sweep is called directly.** The update and delete recoveries, and every quiet window, `await` the private `resync()`, the same body the timer runs. A quiet window is now `QUIET_SWEEPS = 3` sweeps, where the old window was sized at "comfortably more than two sweeps". `self-write-suppression.test.ts` and `external-delete-requires-absence.test.ts` already test this package this way. The watcher stays blinded exactly as before, so a recovered event can only come from a sweep.
- **Two cases are stricter.** In the unreadable-directory case, the first sweep that meets the fault must report it. In the ENOENT case, every driven sweep must hit the injected ENOENT (`enoentServed`). Before this change, the ENOENT case passed even if no sweep ran.
- The fixed 200 ms sleep after `put()` in the unreadable-directory case is gone. `put()` is awaited and sets the head in the same continuation.
- `RECOVERY_WAIT_MS` and `CASE_TIMEOUT_MS` are unchanged. No case was deleted, skipped or moved.

## Wall time

Vitest module line, in ms, on a shared 4-core box under `os-verify-lock`:

| | BASE `6f4c518b01` | AFTER `43fef097df` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| file alone | 24228 / 24364 (a verbose run: tests 24.18 s) | 3331 / 3303 / 3356 |
| package suite, `--maxWorkers=2` | 24226 / 24229 | 3387 / 3330 |
| package suite, `--maxWorkers=8` (2x oversubscribed) | NOT MEASURED | 3348 |

- **Per case AFTER:** about 2055 ms for create/update/delete (the one scheduled sweep), about 1150 ms for exactly-once (the live watcher's 1 s poll), and under 110 ms for each of the other three.
- **Package suite:** 11 files and 74 tests pass, before and after. The suite's summed test time fell from 34.6 s to 13.8 s.
- **CI after this change:** NOT MEASURED here. This PR's own Test Core log will carry the module line.
- `origin/main` (`afbf960c26`, which touches nothing in this package) was merged before the AFTER readings.

## Ablation: every case can still fail

Each leg changed `src/repository.ts` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the marker was on disk. Each leg then ran the new file and a temporary copy of the BASE file in one vitest run. Afterwards, the file was restored to the HEAD blob `f76f6dee4f48`, with `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../src/index.js`, so no dist is involved.

| leg | mutation | red cases, this PR | red cases, BASE |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `resync()` returns at once | 1, 3, 4 | 1, 3 |
| A2 | `scheduleResync()` never arms | 1 | 1, 3 |
| A3 | the chain never re-arms | 1 (re-arm assertion) | 1 (update) |
| A4 | the sweep forgets `heads` before each file | 1, 2 | 1, 2 |
| A5 | the fault latch is removed | 3 (3 reports) | 3 (3 reports) |
| A6 | an unreadable type is not recorded | none | none |
| A8 | A6, plus the delete pass's `existsSync` re-check removed | 3 (2 deletes) | 3 (2 deletes) |
| A7 | ENOENT is reported as a fault | 4 | 4 |

- **A2 is the one place where this PR reds fewer cases.** At BASE, the unreadable-directory case also needed the scheduler. Now only case 1 does, so the scheduler half of the pin rests on case 1's scheduled create and its re-arm assertion.
- **A6 stays green on both trees.** The delete pass re-checks the disk under the per-key lock, which is a second guard. A8 removes both guards and turns case 3 red on both trees.
- **A1 reds case 4 here but not at BASE,** because the old ENOENT case passed without any sweep.

## Gates, lint and typecheck (at `43fef097df`)

- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 49 commands, identical to the dispatch list. All 49 ran. `--ran` with exit codes reads "49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist). Both were re-run green after `turbo run build` (75 tasks, 73 from cache).
  - `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` was also re-run after the build: 70 packages, 554 maps.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-fs typecheck` exits 0. `tsc --listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` names the test file once.
- **Lint (narrowed to the one file):** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 1 file, 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  - `--print-config` returns a config for the file, so it is linted.
  - Its parserOptions are `ecmaVersion` and `sourceType` only. Without type-aware linting, the diff cannot change any other file's result.
- **Bytes:** `check:nul-bytes` exits 0, and a control-byte scan of the file finds 0 lines.

## No changeset

This diff changes only a test. I built the package with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-fs build` and searched its `files` (`dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`). The test-only names `QUIET_SWEEPS`, `reportedByFirstSweep`, `enoentServed` and `blindWatcher` have 0 hits. The production controls `RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS` and `reportResyncFault` hit 2 and 4 files. `skip-changeset` is labelled.

## Acceptance notes

- This row's pin is the next refresh PR's list no longer naming this file.
- Outside the module line: a single-file run of this package spends 12.5 to 15.2 s in vitest's import phase (the `import` figure in the summary line), and no module line reports it. This is an observation only and is not filed. Carrier: none.
